name: Brahma
tagline: Generates genetically accurate synthetic mice as digital twins to reduce animal testing.

awards: Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban

problem: Animal testing in preclinical research is slow, costly and ethically fraught.
solution: Links synthetic genomes, predicted phenotypes and simulations into on-demand digital mouse models for researchers and agents, via tool protocols.
demo_moment: Team-described: generate a synthetic mouse and run a simulation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban” among 195 submissions.
Targets an ethical problem in research.
Biological accuracy of the synthetic data is unverified in the summary.

lessons: Ambitious science claims need evidence on the slide.
